documented_evidence: Selected producer/project evidence and survey responses describe qualification, storage, supply, and performance issues.
evidence_limit: Case/survey evidence is not nationally representative; some material is not PLC-specific.
model_representation: Persistent binary a_i; readiness r_i=logistic(kappa*(d_i+phi_s+p_i-B0)); monthly hazard h_i=clip(x_i*lambda_A*r_i,0,1); lambda_A=1-exp(-1/T_A).
assumption_or_unidentified_quantity: Response functional form, adoption response period, and weights are calibrated/model assumptions.
causal_status: not identified by this evidence inventory
review_status: runner code verified; source evidence not re-audited
